title: Tab Context Capsule
user: Researchers and knowledge workers with overloaded browser sessions who need to stop, hand off, and resume a small project context without trusting a browser's fragile tab restore.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension that turns selected tabs into a named capsule with title, URL, optional one-line note, ordering, next step, and Markdown/JSON export; it can reopen a capsule locally.
constraints: Private-window support is opt-in and never silently persisted
